option_relations.rationale: VP Shunt Infection is a specific type of infection that can be caused by Brucellosis, making Brucellosis (cutaneous manifestation and VP shunt infection) a broader category that encompasses VP Shunt Infection.
Cutaneous brucellosis describes a skin manifestation of brucellosis, but does not directly relate to the VP shunt infection leaf.
Subcutaneous abscess secondary to Brucella infection describes a localized infection, but does not directly relate to the VP shunt infection leaf.

Brucella melitensis soft tissue abscess related to ventriculoperitoneal shunt is a specific description of a VP shunt infection caused by Brucella melitensis, which is equivalent to the general concept of VP Shunt Infection in this context.
